2.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_Q1_000_000
2.description: Select a data archive to view log entries.

15.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_200
15.description: (-Misija-)During the Third Astral Era, Queen Gunnhildr united the fragmented tribes of the Hrothgar to rise up and drove off the Allagans, eventually going on to found the nation of Bozja.

16.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_201
16.description: (-Misija-)It should be noted that Gunnhildr was not her name, but rather a title bestowed to the current monarch of any given age. The common thread connecting all rulers of Bozja is their ability to read the stars. There were others who shared in this ability, but they were said to be the greatest seers of their respective ages.

17.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_202
17.description: (-Misija-)They were also said to be great warriors. When doing battle with the Allagans or any other would-be invaders, the queen could always be found commanding from the front lines.

18.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_203
18.description: (-Misija-)Alas, Bozja would fall in the wake of the Fourth Umbral Calamity. By some miracle, some few survived and were able to build what we knew as the city-state of Bozja.

19.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_300
19.description: (-Misija-)They were the elite guard of the queen, masters of myriad arms and magicks, said to be the greatest warriors of their age.

20.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_301
20.description: (-Misija-)Their combat prowess was matched only by their devotion to Queen Gunnhildr. They would not hesitate to give their lives in her service. And, should one of these warriors fall in battle, their holy blade would be passed on to a suitable successor.

21.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_302
21.description: (-Misija-)Over time, their title as Gunnhildr's Blades would become synonymous with the gunblade, which gained great renown during the war against the Allagans.

22.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_303
22.description: (-Misija-)There is not a Bozjan alive who does not know the tales of their heroism. I have no doubt reforging these weapons will lend us both the strength and resolve we need to succeed.

23.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_400
23.description: (-Misija-)With Master Gerolt's help, we have nearly all that is required to reforge the weapons of Queen Gunnhildr's guard.

24.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_401
24.description: (-Misija-)While it is true the legends of their might are duly inspiring, to simply call them the blades of Gunnhildr would do little to differentiate these new armaments from the weapons of eld. After all, we do not wish to give the impression that the originals have been recovered.

25.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_402
25.description: (-Misija-)After much thought, Master Gerolt offered a simple and surprisingly satisfactory suggestion of “Resistance weapons.”

26.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_403
26.description: (-Misija-)He also went on to make a rather curious remark about the steps to be taken in their forging: that these weapons can be enhanced further in accordance with the enemies one faces.

27.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_404
27.description: (-Misija-)By the sounds of it, these weapons are never truly complete until their purpose is fulfilled.

28.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_500
28.description: (-Misija-)It has been two years since I joined the Resistance. Before then I lived as all Bozjans did─under the harsh rule of the Empire.

29.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_501
29.description: (-Misija-)It is the only life I have ever known, though my parents often spoke to me of what they remembered from the days of Bozja's independence.

30.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_502
30.description: (-Misija-)Though it was under the auspices of our Garlean oppressors, I was educated in prehistoric archaeology.

31.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_503
31.description: (-Misija-)While I am thankful for the opportunities it afforded me, I could not turn a blind eye to the suffering of my people. And so I left to join the Resistance.

32.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_400_504
32.description: (-Misija-)It was I who proposed to reforge the fabled weapons of Queen Gunnhildr's guard, and Bajsaljen has chosen to place his faith in my plan. I take heart in knowing all I learned from the Empire will be put to good use.

39.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_200
39.description: (-Bajsaljen-)Our home rests in the southern reaches of Ilsabard, to the west of Dalmasca.

40.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_201
40.description: (-Bajsaljen-)Our earliest records─or at least those we have been able to recover─suggest Bozja was founded at some point during the Third Astral Era. The Allagan Empire had reached the height of its power, and several tribes of the Hrothgar came here seeking refuge from their supremacy.

41.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_202
41.description: (-Bajsaljen-)It was Queen Gunnhildr who would keep the Allagans at bay. Her radiance would light our path to prosperity, and by her grace was the nation of Bozja founded.

42.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_203
42.description: (-Bajsaljen-)Alas, the Fourth Umbral Calamity would see the end of her kingdom. But those who survived slowly rebuilt, and Bozja was reborn as a city-state that would coexist with neighboring nations for centuries to come.

43.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_204
43.description: (-Bajsaljen-)The Garlean Empire's rise to power changed everything. None could oppose the sheer strength and versatility of their military.

44.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_205
44.description: (-Bajsaljen-)Their campaign began some fifty years ago, and now an entire generation of our people has been raised knowing only oppression. But now they would know freedom.

45.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_206
45.description: (-Bajsaljen-)When word reached us that Ala Mhigo and Doma had risen up to defy the Empire, we seized the opportunity to flee and form pockets of resistance.

46.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_225
46.description: (-Bajsaljen-)We have come a long way in our fight against the imperials, thanks in no small part to Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. Why, without <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> timely assistance, the revival of Gunnhildr's Blades would have been little more than a dream.

47.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_226
47.description: (-Bajsaljen-)And with our forces consolidated, we were able to force back the IVth Legion, affording us the opportunity to seize Castrum Lacus Litore.

48.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_230
48.description: (-Bajsaljen-)Though Queen Gunnhildr no longer poses a threat, we will be hard-pressed to overcome the imperials' reinforcements. But we mustn't give in to despair. To do so would be a dishonor to those who laid down their lives for the future of Bozja.

49.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_300
49.description: (-Bajsaljen-)For the present, this is our base of operations, to the southeast of what remains of Bozja Citadel. When the fighting begins, we will hold the line here.

50.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_301
50.description: (-Bajsaljen-)For a blessing, the surrounding wetlands and the fog that persists year-round have served to conceal our operation. That is not to say, of course, we have not taken additional measures to remain hidden.

51.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_302
51.description: (-Bajsaljen-)In the unlikely event that their scouts should approach the perimeter, our mages have cast a cloaking spell around the area to keep us from sight.

52.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_303
52.description: (-Bajsaljen-)Havens such as this are plentiful along the southern coast of Ilsabard. Our facilities are rather modest, I confess, but I would like to think we have made great strides in providing for our soldiers here.

53.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_400
53.description: (-Bajsaljen-)It was roughly twenty years ago, if I'm not mistaken. The Empire, fearful of the threat posed by primals and the tribes who summoned them, devised a plan to wipe them out.

54.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_401
54.description: (-Bajsaljen-)The Meteor project. Through the use of magitek, they intended to recreate ancient sorcery capable of calling down meteors.

55.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_402
55.description: (-Bajsaljen-)At the helm of the project was their chief engineer, Midas nan Garlond. In time, every last one of their research facilities was involved in its development.

56.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_403
56.description: (-Bajsaljen-)The project would take a perilous turn when it was discovered that the lesser moon Dalamud was, in fact, a satellite of Allagan design. They were determined to make it part of their plans.

57.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_404
57.description: (-Bajsaljen-)And so they erected a colossal transmission tower, designed to control Dalamud. Its first test would also prove to be its last...

58.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_405
58.description: (-Bajsaljen-)For lack of eyewitnesses, what happened next is difficult to describe. It is often described as an explosion, but the ruins showed no signs of gunpowder or magic. We only know that a terrible light shone from the heavens that night.

59.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_406
59.description: (-Bajsaljen-)In an instant, the citadel was gone. Its citizens and soldiers...my family...

60.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_101_407
60.description: (-Bajsaljen-)It is a terrifying thought that Bahamut is the reason Dalamud responded with such destructive force, but needless to say, all work on the Meteor project was halted immediately.

61.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_408
61.description: (-Bajsaljen-)Five years later, however, Nael van Darnus set the wheels of the project back into motion. His devotion was rewarded with the coming of the Seventh Umbral Calamity.

62.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_409
62.description: (-Bajsaljen-)The world has already paid too great a cost for the Garleans' ambition... They must be stopped.

63.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_430
63.description: (-Bajsaljen-)As you know, Queen Gunnhildr was protected by an elite guard known as Gunnhildr's Blades. Their title would one day lend itself to the most renowned of their weaponry─the gunblade, but each of her guard was said to have mastered a unique weapon.

64.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_431
64.description: (-Bajsaljen-)These blades were said to be blessed by the gods, and in the unlikely event one of the queen's guard should fall in battle, their weapon was passed on to a suitable successor.

65.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_432
65.description: (-Bajsaljen-)When Lord Hien suggested we find a symbol our people might rally behind, we were admittedly at a loss. For lack of a living figurehead, we looked to the past, and there we found our answer─the blades of Gunnhildr.

66.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_433
66.description: (-Bajsaljen-)It was a simple solution, in principle, but without the help of Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, and that of Mikoto and Master Gerolt, we never could have succeeded. I believe I speak for all of us when I say we are eternally grateful for what <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> has done.

67.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_434
67.description: (-Bajsaljen-)With the weapons of Queen Gunnhildr forged anew, we then bestowed them upon our finest soldiers. Indeed, the illustrious Gunnhildr's Blades have been reborn.

68.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_450
68.description: (-Bajsaljen-)I was so certain our plan would succeed... But who could have foreseen Queen Gunnhildr herself being turned against us? Our soldiers, Gunnhildr's Blades, made her slaves.

69.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_451
69.description: (-Bajsaljen-)It was indeed a heavy blow to morale, but I know they would not want us to mourn their passing. As was tradition in the days of old, we must find capable soldiers to carry on in their stead, and press onward. Come what may, Bozja will be freed from the Empire.

70.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_500
70.description: (-Bajsaljen-)I was born in Bozja, though I have never known a life free from the Empire's rule.

71.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_501
71.description: (-Bajsaljen-)Following in my late father's footsteps, I studied to become a doctor. Much to my surprise, and dismay, my academic accomplishments did not go unnoticed. I was taken to the capital, where I received a formal education in medicinal sciences. Deployment as a medic in their military soon followed.

72.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_502
72.description: (-Bajsaljen-)My service was ultimately rewarded with citizenship, after which I met my wife, and we started a family together. If their goal was for me to grow content and complacent, it failed, for not a day went by that I did not think about the liberation of my homeland.

73.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_503
73.description: (-Bajsaljen-)But I would need to bide my time a while longer, for I was assigned to the IVth Imperial Legion. There was an uprising in Nagxia, and it fell to us to quell their insurrection. It was not until after our mission was complete that I learned of what happened to Bozja. To my family...

74.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_504
74.description: (-Bajsaljen-)We returned as fast as we were able, but there was nothing left of the citadel.

75.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_505
75.description: (-Bajsaljen-)I was ordered to return to the capital, but I had to find my wife and children. I covered every ilm of that barren wasteland...and nothing.

76.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_506
76.description: (-Bajsaljen-)Chains and a prison cell greeted me back in Garlemald, but in spite of my confinement, whispers of what happened in Bozja eventually reached me. Of their failed experiments to control Dalamud.

77.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_507
77.description: (-Bajsaljen-)Stripped of my citizenship, I expected to remain under lock and key until the end of my days. Fortunately for me, they had need of more medics for their next campaign.

78.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_508
78.description: (-Bajsaljen-)But I would never reach the battlefield, for I escaped with a number of other soldiers to join the Resistance.

79.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BAISHAEN_100_509
79.description: (-Bajsaljen-)Many years of service to the Resistance then molded me into the man I am today. And I will continue to serve for as long as it takes to see our homeland safe from the Empire.

87.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_200
87.description: (-Marsak-)The initial invasion of Bozja was led by Basch van Gabranth. There would be a change of commander not long after, however.

88.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_201
88.description: (-Marsak-)Thirty years ago, during the invasion of Dalmasca, his health took an unexpected turn for the worse, and his son, Noah van Gabranth, oversaw the conquest to its completion. He was a mere twenty years old when he assumed full command.

89.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_202
89.description: (-Marsak-)The IVth Imperial Legion itself is rather unique compared to most, for the bulk of their forces are not native Garleans, their present leader included.

90.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_203
90.description: (-Marsak-)Both Noah and his father were quite quick to bend the knee to Emperor Solus, from what I have been told. Perhaps it was that ardent loyalty that helped them rise to such prominence.

91.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_204
91.description: (-Marsak-)But not all were such fervent followers of the Empire. Quite the contrary, I would hazard the greater part of their soldiers were like us, seeing little recourse but to serve lest they be put to the sword.

92.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_205
92.description: (-Marsak-)Though I suppose the unwavering loyalty of the IVth Imperial Legion is what serves to set it apart from the rest. Or to be more precise, its loyalty to Noah van Gabranth.

93.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_206
93.description: (-Marsak-)What's more, they are not wont to rely on magitek armaments like most imperial soldiers.

94.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_207
94.description: (-Marsak-)Indeed, they seem to prefer fighting the old-fashioned way, employing arcane magicks, techniques akin to summoning, and all manner of feral beasts rather than depending on heavy artillery.

95.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_220
95.description: (-Marsak-)The IVth Legion's remaining forces are being led by Menenius, allowing Lyon to freely roam the southern front as he pleases.

96.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_221
96.description: (-Marsak-)And, of course, there is Misija. It will be quite some time before we recover from the losses her betrayal has caused us.

97.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_300
97.description: (-Marsak-)Ah yes, the leader of the IVth Imperial Legion, one of the youngest to ever take such a position. His father, Basch van Gabranth, served as legatus before him, claiming many a victory in the name of the Empire.

98.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_301
98.description: (-Marsak-)Basch was a knight of the Republic of Landis, which, like so many other nations, was fast to fall at the hands of the Empire. Rather than die with dignity, he was quite quick to bend the knee to their conquerors, ingratiating himself with the Emperor and earning his place as a legatus.

99.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_302
99.description: (-Marsak-)This was quite a feat, given that he was not of Garlean blood. One can but imagine the lengths to which he went to earn their trust, but it is clear he labored hard to keep it.

100.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_303
100.description: (-Marsak-)His health took an unexpected turn for the worse during the invasion of Dalmasca, which afforded Noah the opportunity he needed to rise to prominence. And it was under Noah's leadership that Rabanastre would fall.

101.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_304
101.description: (-Marsak-)Then, when his father passed two years later, he was named the next legatus of the IVth Imperial Legion.

102.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_305
102.description: (-Marsak-)Many believe it was the conquest of Dalmasca that earned him the position, but some argue he was appointed on the recommendation of the Emperor, perhaps in recognition of his father's service to the Empire.

103.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_306
103.description: (-Marsak-)Regardless of the reason, Noah would continue in his father's footsteps. The IVth Imperial Legion would continue to be comprised primarily of foreign soldiers, and their loyalty to the newly appointed legatus was unfaltering.

104.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_307
104.description: (-Marsak-)One might expect such a legion to remain within the Emperor's good graces, but it would not be so when Varis took the throne. For several years he appointed them to the quelling of uprisings in remote provinces, as if to keep them at arm's length.

105.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_308
105.description: (-Marsak-)Perhaps he suspected an ulterior motive to the Gabranths seeking to gain such fervent adoration from the IVth Imperial Legion. I have no proof, of course, but one cannot help but wonder...

106.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_400
106.description: (-Marsak-)It was once known as Alermuc Fortress, erected in the hopes of deterring the Garleans. After the Bozja incident, it would be rebuilt and given a new name─Castrum Lacus Litore.

107.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_401
107.description: (-Marsak-)Its position to the north of Bozja will make it a critical strategic point in the battles to come. If we are to have any hope of reclaiming Bozja, we must first gain control of the castrum.

108.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_402
108.description: (-Marsak-)The location was originally chosen for its natural defenses. Being surrounded on all sides by steep cliffs made Alermuc Fortress all but impregnable. Assuming, of course, one had the wherewithal to defend it.

109.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_403
109.description: (-Marsak-)When the Garleans came, their magitek weaponry was unlike anything we had ever seen. A great many lives were lost in our struggle to hold the fortress, and in the end we were simply outmatched.

110.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_415
110.description: (-Marsak-)Our plan to retake the castrum seemed without fault, and was executed to the letter. If not for Misija, we would likely be having this conversation there rather than here.

111.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_416
111.description: (-Marsak-)So many lives have been lost to her treachery...

112.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_417
112.description: (-Marsak-)My only solace is in the knowledge that Menenius has withdrawn from the castrum. With its defense systems no longer functioning, I suspect he fears heavier losses should we launch another assault.

113.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_450
113.description: (-Marsak-)At present, the castrum is held by Legatus Gabranth's second-in-command, Menenius rem Lanatus, or I suppose I should say Menenius sas Lanatus, if our intelligence is to be believed. It would appear he was recently promoted to commanding officer of the legion's forces.

114.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_451
114.description: (-Marsak-)Lanatus is a well-known family with a long and august lineage. That is, until they incurred the ire of the Emperor, tarnishing their name and robbing them of their position in Garlean society.

115.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_452
115.description: (-Marsak-)And yet Basch van Gabranth would choose members of their family to serve under him. Mayhap he sensed their desperation to redeem their honor. If that is the case, the road to redemption is long indeed, for two generations of Lanatus have served under the Gabranths.

116.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_453
116.description: (-Marsak-)A curious state of affairs considering the information recently pried from one of our prisoners. If they are to be believed, Menenius is not of Garlean descent─he is an Elezen. Adoption of a non-Garlean by nobles is unprecedented.

117.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_454
117.description: (-Marsak-)Only the gods know what inexplicable twist of fate would drive them to do such a thing, but I can understand why they would remain at the side of one who seeks the discarded and otherwise undesirable.

118.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_455
118.description: (-Marsak-)Menenius serves as their chief intelligence officer, and as one might imagine, the greater part of his time is spent recruiting and dispatching spies, plotting how best to subvert their enemies.

119.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_456
119.description: (-Marsak-)It yet remains to be seen if Misija was a spy from the start, or if they persuaded her to turn against us, but I have no doubt that what has happened was all according to his plans.

120.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_457
120.description: (-Marsak-)What I find more concerning, however, is how they are still able to recruit more soldiers to their cause with their empty promises of a new nation.

121.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_458
121.description: (-Marsak-)We would do well not to underestimate them. There is no telling what they may attempt next to thwart us.

122.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_500
122.description: (-Marsak-)I serve primarily as liaison 'twixt the Bozjan Resistance and our allies. I'll not deny there is still much for me to learn, but I will do everything within my power to see Bozja free of the Empire. If that should mean my life, then so be it.

123.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_501
123.description: (-Marsak-)...My past? It is no different than most, I would imagine─conscription by the Empire, which is the only reason I was not present in the citadel to die alongside my kin in the Bozja incident.

124.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_502
124.description: (-Marsak-)Some would call it a massacre planned by the Empire, but I am not ready to believe they would willingly kill so many of their own soldiers and engineers.

125.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_503
125.description: (-Marsak-)Having been raised under the Garlean doctrine, I realize that not all of them are the bloodthirsty monsters many of us would paint them to be. Though the Empire would seek to oppress us, I do not share the same animosity towards its citizens as my Resistance comrades.

126.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_504
126.description: (-Marsak-)But these are musings better left unspoken. I would not have the others think me a coward or a traitor to our cause.

127.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_605
127.description: (-Marsak-)Despite what few resources we have to spare, Bajsaljen has carried out an investigation into Misija and her past. The results were...not what we expected.

128.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_606
128.description: (-Marsak-)We could find absolutely no inconsistencies in her family or military records. One might say she was lying with the truth.

129.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_607
129.description: (-Marsak-)From the first, she was one of us. A woman of Bozja... And despite everything that has happened, I believe she is still one of us.

130.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_608
130.description: (-Marsak-)<sigh> No doubt she would say such naivety is what cost the lives of so many.

131.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_615
131.description: (-Marsak-)There is so much blood on her hands, and yet I still cannot find it within me to hate her.

132.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_616
132.description: (-Marsak-)For the interim she will remain in our gaol underground, a guard watching her cell at all times, lest someone seize an opportunity to do her harm.

133.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_617
133.description: (-Marsak-)Under Bajsaljen's orders, she will face trial after the imperials have been dealt with. I cannot say I agree with his decision to wait, but it is not mine to make.

134.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MARSHAK_200_618
134.description: (-Marsak-)Until then, I thought perhaps she might be willing to speak with us, offer intelligence on the enemy to gain some modicum of leniency in her sentencing. Alas, she refuses to talk.

143.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_200
143.description: (-Mikoto-)Scant though they are, the records we have uncovered thus far suggest the practices of seers date back as far as the Fourth Astral Era.

144.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_201
144.description: (-Mikoto-)The region was plagued with all manner of natural disasters in those days, inciting great unrest not only amongst the Bozjans, but neighboring nations as well.

145.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_202
145.description: (-Mikoto-)It was during these tumultuous times seers first appeared. In fact, I have reason to believe they possessed the Echo.

146.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_203
146.description: (-Mikoto-)Using a crystal focus, they were able to delve into the minds of the downcast and the heartsick, seeking out their darkest memories and altering them to ease the peoples' burdens.

147.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_204
147.description: (-Mikoto-)Perhaps they saw the altering of minds as a necessity for their survival, but we must consider the ethical implications of such methods in this day and age. I have no doubt my betters in Sharlayan would consider it to be reprehensible.

148.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_300
148.description: (-Mikoto-)My initial analysis of the crystals suggests they are man-made. Nothing in my data can prove the materials are unique to this region, which leads me to believe the Bozjans─or rather, the seers─created them.

149.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_301
149.description: (-Mikoto-)However, given the intricate lattices found in these crystals, it seems highly improbable that the Bozjans could have produced them, considering the methods available to them in the Fourth Astral Era.

150.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_302
150.description: (-Mikoto-)In fact, on closer inspection, it became clear that its structure is quite similar to that found in Allagan constructs.

151.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_303
151.description: (-Mikoto-)Which then begs the question: who were the seers, and whence did they come? This is but a working theory, but I suspect their roots can be traced back to the Allagans themselves─perhaps survivors of the Fourth Umbral Calamity who wished to atone for the sins of their forebears.

152.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_304
152.description: (-Mikoto-)They came to these lands seeking a means to help the Bozjans, and in doing so created these crystal foci.

153.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_305
153.description: (-Mikoto-)...Ahem. As I said, 'tis but a working theory. Though I understand if it sounds more like a flight of fancy.

154.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_400
154.description: (-Mikoto-)Perhaps I should start with a simple explanation, as I did before. Let us consider the composition of a person's aether, shall we? There is corporeal aether of the flesh, incorporeal aether of the soul, and the aetherial residue of an individual's memories.

155.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_401
155.description: (-Mikoto-)Were one to be possessed of only corporeal aether, they would be but a walking corpse. Conversely, entities comprised of only incorporeal aether are referred to in layman's terms as ghosts. Of course, a ghost that possesses residual memories could likely recall its past and retain self-awareness.

156.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_402
156.description: (-Mikoto-)Using a crystal focus, we can isolate the aetherial signature of memories, much in the same way the seers did. We can then delve into and explore specific memories conjured by the subject.

157.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_403
157.description: (-Mikoto-)We must be careful of what we observe, however, for while the information stored in a person's memories can be quite comprehensive, it is not always true to fact. They can be distorted due to the passage of time, or even when first committed to the mind as a result of personal bias.

158.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_404
158.description: (-Mikoto-)That is why it is important to mark the distinction between explicit and implicit memories.

159.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_405
159.description: (-Mikoto-)Explicit memories are those consciously stored and recalled, while implicit memories are more passively accumulated by our subconscious.

160.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_406
160.description: (-Mikoto-)When meeting someone for the first time, their appearance will be kept as part of our explicit memory, though this may fade with the passing of time. Should a great deal of time pass without meeting, however, such recollection can prove difficult.

161.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_407
161.description: (-Mikoto-)Yet in that moment, your mind also takes record of everything experienced by your sensory nervous system.

162.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_408
162.description: (-Mikoto-)Unfortunately, information called from explicit memory is quite sensitive to misrepresentations of events. After all, if an individual is actively choosing to recall an event, who is to say they will not make alterations to better suit their liking?

163.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_409
163.description: (-Mikoto-)That is why we seek information from implicit memory, which is more likely to be preserved free of the bias of an individual's worldview.

164.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_500
164.description: (-Mikoto-)The Echo can manifest itself in myriad ways dependent on the individual. I was gifted with the ability to peer into the future.

165.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_501
165.description: (-Mikoto-)It is a power much like prophetic dreams and divinations, and yet quite different, for such visions only tell of the future's potential.

166.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_502
166.description: (-Mikoto-)The Echo does not show me what may happen, but what <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> happen.

167.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_503
167.description: (-Mikoto-)Scholars speculate Mezaya Thousand Eyes too shared this gift, hence the alarming accuracy of the passages writ in her <hex:021A020203>Divine Chronicles<hex:021A020103>.

168.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_504
168.description: (-Mikoto-)These visions are a decidedly rare occurrence, usually containing some crucial insight into matters presently unfolding before me. For better or worse, I have never had visions of an impending threat on my life or those around me.

169.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_505
169.description: (-Mikoto-)Not that I would want to see such things, of course. Could you imagine, knowing of certain doom that cannot be avoided?

170.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_506
170.description: (-Mikoto-)I once spoke of my visions to an acquaintance─a relatively harmless glimpse of the future─and it resulted in a terrible argument. I fear I could not bear the weight of grimmer tidings...

171.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_507
171.description: (-Mikoto-)But that is neither here nor there. My gift is but a trivial thing. Nothing anyone should think to rely upon.

172.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_520
172.description: (-Mikoto-)Legend has it that, when the Fourth Umbral Calamity threatened to destroy all of Bozja, Queen Gunnhildr used the power of her holy blade, Save the Queen, to save her people.

173.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_521
173.description: (-Mikoto-)Misija called it a primal summoning, claiming the queen was able to control its power much like Lady Ysayle harnessed the power of Shiva.

174.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_522
174.description: (-Mikoto-)The apparition we saw in the memory assumed the form of what I presume was Queen Gunnhildr, the entity Misija summoned adopting the same appearance.

175.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_523
175.description: (-Mikoto-)As to why it would take such a form, I believe it is linked to the nature of Queen Gunnhildr's death at the hands of her guard.

176.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_524
176.description: (-Mikoto-)This is but a theory, mind, but if the residual aether of her memories was absorbed by the blade, it stands to reason Save the Queen could gain some semblance of sentience.

177.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_525
177.description: (-Mikoto-)Curious that Misija was somehow able to control it. I can only assume this was made possible through our shared use of the crystal focus.

178.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_535
178.description: (-Mikoto-)A pity it was destroyed, though I suppose it is for the best. We are ill-suited to using it as the seers of eld did, and now the spirit of Queen Gunnhildr can never again be manipulated for nefarious ends.

179.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_536
179.description: (-Mikoto-)Even so, as long as Save the Queen exists, there remains the risk of its power being abused.

180.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_537
180.description: (-Mikoto-)But I wonder... Could the aether which comprised the queen's memories still reside in the blade? Without the crystal focus, perhaps we will never know.

181.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_540
181.description: (-Mikoto-)I believe the term was coined after confrontations with the primal Ifrit. The creature would bombard its enemies with a veritable deluge of aether, rendering them mindless slaves.

182.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_541
182.description: (-Mikoto-)Though perhaps it would be more accurate to say their will is supplanted by that of the primal. They will act instinctively according to its whims and desires, no matter how depraved or immoral.

183.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_301_542
183.description: (-Mikoto-)The effect was believed to be irreversible, but the Scions are said to have discovered a cure. I imagine it will not be long before the method of treatment is shared with the Resistance.

184.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_545
184.description: (-Mikoto-)Thankfully the Warrior of Light and I are gifted with the Echo, otherwise the queen would likely bid us join the ranks of the afflicted.

185.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_550
185.description: (-Mikoto-)We can only hope the treatment for tempering reaches us before those affected are irreparably altered. Of course, there is also the matter of seeing to their capture.

186.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_551
186.description: (-Mikoto-)If Bajsaljen should ask for my counsel on the matter, I am honestly at a loss as to what to say. If my negligence should cost more lives in apprehending Gunnhildr's Blades and the other afflicted... It pains me to even imagine it.

187.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_600
187.description: (-Mikoto-)Oh, there really isn't much to tell, I assure you!

188.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_601
188.description: (-Mikoto-)Well, if you must know... Due to advanced placement I found myself attending the Studium much earlier than most. My research in the field of aetherology would eventually earn me the title of Archon. When I am not conducting research in the field, I conduct lectures at the Studium.

189.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_602
189.description: (-Mikoto-)Moenbryda is, er...was...my mentor. I would not be the scholar I am today if not for her. I have fond memories of the many nights we toiled together working on her original plans for the aetheric siphon. She was like a sister to me.

190.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_603
190.description: (-Mikoto-)Speaking of which, I do have a sister, actually. An identical twin, in fact. Though we have not spoken since she too was named an Archon.

191.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_604
191.description: (-Mikoto-)She was my better in all aspects of academia, but she often disagreed with the views of the Forum. I can but assume that is why she took her leave of the Studium.

192.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_605
192.description: (-Mikoto-)She was always so strong-willed and quite critical of those around her. Sadly, we never got along very well growing up. I often wonder if that is why Moenbryda was so quick to take me under her wing.

193.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_606
193.description: (-Mikoto-)I still see her, in my dreams. Always offering a warm smile and words of encouragement.

194.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_MIKOTO_300_607
194.description: (-Mikoto-)If we were to use the crystal focus, perhaps there would be a way to speak with her again. A tempting prospect, but in the end, I know it would not truly be her...

201.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_000
201.description: (-Lilja-)The aether spectrometer? Well, seeing as I haven't read the manual, you'll have to settle for a brief explanation. Hopefully Jessie doesn't hear about this.

202.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_001
202.description: (-Lilja-)Ahem. The idea for it originally came from Mikoto, and the chief─genius that he is─was able to put her ideas to paper. After that, all it took was a little ingenuity from our engineers to bring everything together.

203.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_002
203.description: (-Lilja-)After the sensors are in place and turned on, they analyze the aether currents running through the area, and that data is tracked by our monitors here.

204.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_003
204.description: (-Lilja-)What makes it so invaluable to our plans is its ability to distinguish between varying aetherial signatures. The large aether currents we're tracking are like giant rivers fed by streams of different kinds of aether. But with the spectrometer, we can easily pick out the specific one we need. Fascinating stuff, isn't it?

205.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_100
205.description: (-Lilja-)The what? Oh, right. The chief picked it up on one of his scavenging trips to Allagan ruins somewhere. It's been surprisingly nice to have around. Goodness knows I can't keep track of everything going on here.

206.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_101
206.description: (-Lilja-)Jessie asked that I keep it on at all times. If I'm to be honest, though, I think she just wants to keep a close eye on me. Whether that's a good or a bad thing, I'm not sure.

207.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_200
207.description: (-Lilja-)M-Me!? But I... Why would anyone want to know about me?

208.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_201
208.description: (-Lilja-)Can't imagine I have many common interests with most people. I'd make for terrible company, especially with someone as worldly as the savior of Eorzea, while I'm just a... Oh gods...

209.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_SYSTEM_100_202
209.description: While there is no further audio for this data entry, it appears the drone noted elevated heart rate and body temperature shortly before the recording ended.

210.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_300
210.description: (-Lilja-)The chief came up with the idea after the Dalmascan resistance consulted him on ideas to protect their outposts. In ancient times, certain cities and strongholds there were protected by magicked barriers said to reach up to the heavens.

211.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_301
211.description: (-Lilja-)I'm told the mages performed rather complicated rites to do it, but it basically boiled down to enchanting crystals with protection spells.

212.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_302
212.description: (-Lilja-)Of course, the greater the area covered, the more crystals they required. What's more, in a case such as ours, a veritable army of mages chanting incantations around the clock would be required.

213.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_303
213.description: (-Lilja-)The Dalmascan resistance thought magitek might be able to replicate the effect, and so they called on the chief to hopefully work something out.

214.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_304
214.description: (-Lilja-)The first thing that came to mind was Seiryu's Wall in the Burn: a device that could erect a barrier over a given space using the ambient aether flowing in the ground beneath it.

215.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_305
215.description: (-Lilja-)It was agreed that Bozja had the more pressing need, and so the chief brought his new shielding technology here first. It's on a much smaller scale than Seiryu's Wall, mind, but it certainly does the job.

216.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_306
216.description: (-Lilja-)When building them in Dalmasca, I do hope he remembers that not every land has been suffused with unnaturally high stores of energy like Bozja. Though I shouldn't be worried. This is the chief we're talking about, after all.

217.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_309
217.description: (-Lilja-)At any rate, that's why we have barriers protecting all the outposts out here.

218.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_400
218.description: (-Lilja-)Gosh, it's so exciting seeing one of my inventions put to such good use. It certainly wasn't easy coming up with something to handle such delicate work while also tough enough to survive on the battlefield.

219.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_401
219.description: (-Lilja-)It's a wonder we didn't need them when we first came to the southern front. You'd be surprised at how many aether currents are either too small to be of use, or too fragmented to carry a steady stream of aether.

220.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_402
220.description: (-Lilja-)That's where the defluxion aether manipulators come in!

221.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_LILJA_100_403
221.description: (-Lilja-)There's nothing more motivating than praise from the chief. I can't wait for another chance to show off my engineering know-how.

227.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_000
227.description: (-Bwagi-)Dalmasca? That's precisely why I'm here. Lady Fran asked that I relay the news to Bajsaljen. What I have to say is meant only for his ears, but I suppose she wouldn't be cross if Eorzea's champion were to hear as well.

228.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_001
228.description: (-Bwagi-)The resistance forces in Dalmasca and Nagxia have been planning assaults of their own to coincide with the Bozjan's strike on the castrum here.

229.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_002
229.description: (-Bwagi-)In Dalmasca their target was Castrum Amicitia, known to most as the nigh-impenetrable Nalbina Fortress. Their losses were great, but in the end their efforts were rewarded with victory.

230.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_003
230.description: (-Bwagi-)In Nagxia they succeeded in taking a port to cut off their supply chain. The IVth Legion was surprisingly quick to turn tail from what I've been told.

231.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_004
231.description: (-Bwagi-)The forces in both Dalmasca and Nagxia are overjoyed by their success, but Lady Fran suspects something is amiss. She believes victory should not have been so easily won against the IVth Legion.

232.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_005
232.description: (-Bwagi-)To that end, we have begun tracking their activity more closely. And considering the state of affairs in the Empire, we found it curious there has been little to or from their base of operations in Valnain.

233.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_006
233.description: (-Bwagi-)After the death of Lord Varis, it would be an understatement to say the Empire fell into disarray. It's a war of factions in the truest sense of the word.

234.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_007
234.description: (-Bwagi-)According to our intelligence, the IVth Legion has been ordered to return to the imperial capital, but Gabranth has refused. He's since proclaimed that Dalmasca will be the site of a new nation he intends to build.

235.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_008
235.description: (-Bwagi-)Sounds to me like if he means to continue his fight for Bozja, the IVth Legion will be doing it alone.

236.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_009
236.description: (-Bwagi-)There may never be a more prime opportunity than now to defeat them. There's a growing call to strike, and I'm inclined to agree that we should. But Lady Fran insisted we wait until we better understood the IVth Legion's goal.

237.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_010
237.description: (-Bwagi-)She had hoped the Bozjan's conflict with Gabranth's forces might shed some light on their motives, and it seems her suspicions were well founded.

238.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_015
238.description: (-Bwagi-)Our allies in Dalmasca and Nagxia will be pleased to hear of the Resistance's victories over the imperials thus far. It would not surprise me if the news did not embolden them to hasten their plans to take the offensive.

239.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_016
239.description: (-Bwagi-)Would that we could discern what Gabranth is after here, though. Lady Fran was convinced they would retreat from Bozja, and the loss of Save the Queen only gives them greater cause to fall back.

240.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_017
240.description: (-Bwagi-)Instead they bring an imperial warship. But why? What could they possibly hope to gain by remaining here?

241.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_100
241.description: (-Bwagi-)Me? What's there to tell? A former fusilier to the royal family working with the Resistance against our common enemy─the IVth Legion.

242.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_100_101
242.description: (-Bwagi-)For now, I serve as liaison for Lady Fran. I can already tell there will be much to speak of when I return to Dalmasca.

243.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_200_000
243.description: (-Bwagi-)About the Bangaa? I would have thought you had more pressing matters to attend to. Though I suppose my people are an unfamiliar sight to you Eorzeans. Very well...

244.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_200_001
244.description: (-Bwagi-)To start, it should be noted that we Bangaa are mammals, not reptiles. A common misconception due to our scaly appearance.

245.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_200_002
245.description: (-Bwagi-)I say “scaly,” but these are not, in fact, scales on our skin. When our fur sheds, scant though it may be, patches of it do not grow back. Instead, the skin grows callous and hardens into scalelike patterns.

246.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_200_003
246.description: (-Bwagi-)...What? Is what I'm saying truly so surprising? I suppose you also thought we were born from eggs as well. I will forgive you for your ignorance, if only this once. My brethren would certainly have more than a few choice words to share.

247.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_200_004
247.description: (-Bwagi-)Ahem, now where was I? Ah, yes. We Bangaa are also quite long-lived. On average, I would say we live twice as long as the average Hyur.

248.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_200_005
248.description: (-Bwagi-)We mature by the age of fifteen, shedding our skin once a year. Shedding becomes less frequent after that, occurring once every four to─<hex:02100103>...There's that look again. I know what you're thinking, and I swear to the Twelve if the word “lizard” escapes your lips I will not think twice about cutting them off.

249.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_200_006
249.description: (-Bwagi-)As I was saying, we Bangaa are perhaps known best for our superior sense of smell and hearing, as well as our physical prowess. Our greatest weakness, I am embarrassed to say, lies with our voices.

250.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_200_007
250.description: (-Bwagi-)To be more precise, it is the unique structure of our vocal cords. It makes the incantation of spells rather difficult for us, which is why Bangaa practitioners of magic are exceedingly rare.

251.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_200_008
251.description: (-Bwagi-)Hmmm... What else? There was once a time you could distinguish between clansmen by the color of their skin, but after many years of intermingling such distinctions have become meaningless. Nevertheless, one can never be too mindful.

252.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_200_009
252.description: (-Bwagi-)The Ruga are known to have yellow-brown skin, the Faas have bronze skin, the Bista have red-brown skin, and the Sanga have ash grey skin.

253.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_200_010
253.description: (-Bwagi-)That should suffice, I think. Consider yourself duly educated on the Bangaa. If you should remember anything, I pray it is what <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> to call us.

254.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_300_000
254.description: (-Bwagi-)Have you never seen the <hex:021A020203>Ia'sar<hex:021A020103> before? She was once used to pilot Eorzea's champion to meet with Lady Fran in Rabanastre. You would be hard-pressed to find a finer vessel.

255.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_300_001
255.description: (-Bwagi-)At any rate, we─or rather, my dear brother Ba'Gamnan─first commandeered the ship from the wealthy elite of Ul'dah. After a few modifications by myself and Rinok, I daresay it's the fastest airship to ever grace the skies.

256.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_300_002
256.description: (-Bwagi-)And so we christened her the <hex:021A020203>Ia'sar<hex:021A020103>, meaning “tornado” in the old Dalmascan tongue. Funnily enough, it is a name often given to unruly horses. I can assure you our airship is anything but, so long as you have a delicate touch.

257.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_300_003
257.description: (-Bwagi-)We've grown quite attached to her over the years. Through our highs and lows, the <hex:021A020203>Ia'sar<hex:021A020103> has always been there with us. Why, one might say we think of her as family.

258.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_300_004
258.description: (-Bwagi-)We were admittedly apprehensive when first joining the Dalmascan resistance, fearing we would have to part with our airship, but Lady Fran made sure that would not be the case.

259.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_300_005
259.description: (-Bwagi-)If anything should happen to the <hex:021A020203>Ia'sar<hex:021A020103> here in Bozja, though, I will not mourn her. Having served us so faithfully all these years, I can think of no finer opportunity for her to take her final flight.

260.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_300_006
260.description: (-Bwagi-)“He who fights the river's flow knows naught of the ocean.”<hex:02100103>An old Dalmascan proverb to remind us that those who tug against the threads of fate often fail to see the tapestry woven by our lives.

261.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCSTORAGESYSTEM_00692_BWAGI_300_007
261.description: (-Bwagi-)I believe there is a greater purpose to all that we do, and if fate would have me here, fighting alongside you, then I will not struggle against the river's flow.
